name: SauerkrautLM-MoEdernColBERT (1.5M / 27M / 115M)

lineage.how_derived: new MoEdernBERT encoder (ModernBERT-style with hash embeddings and mixture of experts), trained with Stella-style embedding distillation, then knowledge-distillation pre-training and multilingual fine-tuning (card)

purpose: Multilingual multi-vector (ColBERT) retriever built for German and six other European languages, with documents up to 32k tokens, small and fast enough for phones and edge devices (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file in the 1.5M repo is the Apache License 2.0 (header opened); card tag apache-2.0. Not read in full.

architecture.kind: ColBERT late-interaction encoder, MoEdernBERT: 2 layers, hidden 128, hash embeddings, 2 of 8 GeGLU experts plus a shared expert per layer; 128-dim token vectors, MaxSim scoring (1.5M variant)
architecture.why_this_design: Card: hash embedding cuts the embedding table from 3.8M to 0.48M parameters; a +-256-token sliding window above 513 tokens keeps long documents inside the trained range.

strengths: tiny: 43k docs/s on one GPU, 0.13 ms query latency on an Apple M5 Max (1.5M, vendor)
weaknesses: multi-vector index storage is larger than single-vector
custom code, tooling less common than dense embeddings
the card source is still a draft with a TODO comment about training data and teachers
soft.maturity: VAGO solutions (SauerkrautLM German models); first MoEdernBERT release, 2 weeks old.

tona_fit.reason: A German-first retriever that costs nothing in VRAM and is Apache-2.0: a natural fit for local RAG over German documents next to bge-m3 / Qwen3-Embedding. Needs our own German retrieval check, because all numbers are vendor numbers (comparisons use the vendor's own runs and some public MTEB results marked with a dagger).
blockers: ColBERT multi-vector index support in the retrieval stack
